name: Cam-operation qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies operation by a cam mechanism.
description: This qualifier identifies operation by a cam mechanism. A cam can operate contacts according to its mechanical position. The cam action explains the driving relationship while the contact table explains the electrical sequence.
Where several contacts share one cam-operated assembly, maintain the common device identity and list the states at each defined position. Do not infer that all contacts change at the same instant.
readingNotes: Relate the cam position or sequence to the associated contact truth table.
The cam qualifier alone does not show the full switching programme.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Relate the cam position or sequence to the associated contact truth table.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: The cam qualifier alone does not show the full switching programme.
